name: resource-pill
title: Resource Pill
description: The person's own thing an agent touched — a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides deck, a Drive file, a Meet, a calendar event, a GitHub pull request or issue, a Slack message, an email — as an inline chip with its type's icon and real title, opening it; never a numbered source.

meta.whenToUse: A Doc, Meet, Drive file, Slack message, pull request or other thing of the person's that a connector tool returned or made, named in an answer.
meta.whenNotToUse: A web page the answer cites (SourceList), a workspace record or person mentioned by id (InlineChip), or a file the agent made (FilePreview).
